# Fixture Licensing

The public qualification inputs and supplied tests in this directory are authored
for mrun and licensed under either [MIT](../../LICENSE-MIT) or
[Apache-2.0](../../LICENSE-APACHE), at the recipient's option.

These inputs contain no private repository material or upstream client schemas.
Fixture records declare provenance and license paths. Captures from the released
client remain deferred to its actual public-fixture run and require reviewed
provenance, redistribution and manifest revision before sealing.

The interoperability workspace deliberately fails its supplied test until a client
fixes the off-by-one bug. Do not repair its source while preparing fixtures or
count its failing baseline as a runtime regression. Native token arrays, sealed
hashes and acceptance results are not generated by source preparation.
